artBrief: **Science-fiction arcade.** A whimsical magnetic robot attracts glowing star fragments around a book-shaped power cell. Chunky, readable forms.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Science-fiction arcade. A whimsical magnetic robot attracts glowing star fragments around a book-shaped power cell. Chunky, readable forms. The magnetic robot has a clearly visible horseshoe-shaped magnet arm, a tiny friendly face and a large blue book power cell. Bright gold star fragments against dark indigo, exuberant arcade energy.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
